title: 安全知识问答：吊装带与重物搬运

author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/10_Colour Code of Web Sling SWL of Web Sling/src.py

points.K1: 吊装带的颜色代码（了解）
points.K2: 什么是安全工作载荷（了解）
points.K3: 怎样看出吊装带能吊多重（了解）

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，台上亮着问号灯
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz desk with a glowing question-mark lamp and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全知识问答，今天说说吊装带。
overlay: 安全知识问答：吊装带与重物搬运

shots.scene: 一卷彩色扁平吊装带和一个纸箱图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a coiled colorful flat lifting sling and a heavy cardboard box. No people.
shots.narration: 顺便讲讲实验室怎么搬重东西。

shots.scene: 实验楼门口，一台大型仪器正被吊车吊起
shots.prompt_en: Outside a lab building, a large instrument crate hangs from a small crane on a flat sling, with a warning barrier around it.
shots.narration: 新仪器到了，正在吊进实验楼。

shots.scene: 阿杰想从吊物下面抄近路
shots.prompt_en: The young male student starts to walk under the hanging crate as a shortcut to the building door.
shots.narration: 阿杰想从吊着的箱子下面穿过去。

shots.scene: 老李吹哨，伸手拦住阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer blows a whistle and stretches out his arm to stop the young male student at the barrier.
shots.narration: 老李一声哨响：站住，绕开走！

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the quiz desk and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 这条吊带能吊多重？先认识它。

shots.section_title: 吊装带的颜色代码（了解）
shots.scene: 八条不同颜色的扁平吊装带并排
shots.prompt_en: Eight flat lifting slings in a row: violet, green, yellow, grey, red, brown, blue, and orange. No people.
shots.narration: 吊装带常用颜色区分起吊能力。
overlay: 吊装带的颜色代码（了解）

shots.section_title: 吊装带的颜色代码（了解）
shots.scene: 前四条吊带高亮，旁边重物图标由小到大
shots.prompt_en: The violet, green, yellow and grey slings highlighted, each with a weight icon growing in size. No people.
shots.narration: 原片示例：紫一吨、绿二、黄三、灰四。

shots.section_title: 吊装带的颜色代码（了解）
shots.scene: 后四条吊带高亮，重物图标更大
shots.prompt_en: The red, brown, blue and orange slings highlighted, each with a larger weight icon. No people.
shots.narration: 红五、棕六、蓝八，橙色十吨以上。

shots.section_title: 吊装带的颜色代码（了解）
shots.scene: 欣欣指着吊带上的空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank label sewn onto a yellow sling.
shots.narration: 颜色只是参考，标准不同可能不一样。

shots.section_title: 什么是安全工作载荷（了解）
shots.scene: 吊带和一个重物，中间一条红色上限线
shots.prompt_en: A sling holding a weight icon with a red limit line above it. No people.
shots.narration: 安全工作载荷，就是允许吊的最大重量。
overlay: 什么是安全工作载荷（了解）

shots.section_title: 什么是安全工作载荷（了解）
shots.scene: 超过上限的重物把吊带拉断的示意，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an oversized weight stretching and tearing a sling, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 超过它，吊带就可能断。

shots.section_title: 什么是安全工作载荷（了解）
shots.scene: 斜拉的吊带夹角变大，承载箭头变小
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two sling legs at a wide angle with a shrinking capacity arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 吊挂方式和夹角也会影响承载。

shots.section_title: 怎样看出吊装带能吊多重（了解）
shots.scene: 放大镜对准吊带：颜色、标签、条纹三处
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass moving over a yellow sling, highlighting its color, a blank label, and black stripes. No people.
shots.narration: 怎样看出吊带能吊多重？三个办法。
overlay: 怎样看出吊装带能吊多重（了解）

shots.section_title: 怎样看出吊装带能吊多重（了解）
shots.scene: 放大镜停在空白标签上，标签旁打勾
shots.prompt_en: The magnifying glass stops on the blank label, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 最可靠的是看标签上的标注。

shots.section_title: 怎样看出吊装带能吊多重（了解）
shots.scene: 吊带表面三条黑色竖纹被逐一点亮
shots.prompt_en: Three black stripes on the yellow sling light up one by one. No people.
shots.narration: 有的吊带一条纹代表一吨。

shots.section_title: 怎样看出吊装带能吊多重（了解）
shots.scene: 标签缺失的吊带被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A sling with a missing label, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 标签没了、看不清，就不能用。

shots.scene: 老李双手展开吊带仔细查看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unrolls a flat sling and inspects it closely with both hands.
shots.narration: 吊带每次用前，都要先检查。

shots.scene: 割口、磨损、烧焦、化学腐蚀四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons of sling damage: a cut, a worn frayed edge, a burn mark, and a chemical stain. No people.
shots.narration: 割伤、磨损、烧伤、腐蚀，立即停用。

shots.scene: 吊带绕过锐角处加了护套
shots.prompt_en: A sling wrapped around a sharp edge of a crate with a protective sleeve in between. No people.
shots.narration: 绕过锐边要加护套。

shots.scene: 起重机司机出示空白证件
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a hard hat shows a blank certificate card next to a small crane.
shots.narration: 开起重机、做司索，都要持证。

shots.scene: 无证人员去开吊车，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person without a badge climbing into a crane cab, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 无证不能操作，学生更不能上手。

shots.scene: 王老师核对搬运单位的空白资质和吊装方案
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank qualification certificate and a blank lifting plan handed over by the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 仪器吊装，由有资质的单位按方案做。

shots.scene: 老李举手打指挥手势
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in a hard hat signals with raised hands to direct the crane.
shots.narration: 现场有专人指挥。

shots.scene: 吊装区域四周拉着警戒线
shots.prompt_en: A lifting area surrounded by barrier tape and warning signs, a crate hanging in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 吊装区域拉警戒，无关人员不进。

shots.scene: 吊物下方站人的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person standing under a hanging load, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 吊物下面，绝不站人、不穿行。

shots.scene: 阿杰绕着警戒线外侧走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks around the outside of the barrier tape, keeping clear of the hanging crate.
shots.narration: 阿杰绕开走，多走几步不吃亏。

shots.scene: 阿杰想一个人搬一大箱试剂
shots.prompt_en: The young male student bends over a heavy box of reagent bottles, about to lift it alone.
shots.narration: 实验室里，也常要搬重东西。

shots.scene: 弯腰搬重物的小人图标被打叉，屈膝搬的打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two pictograms: one lifting with a bent back, crossed out; one lifting with bent knees and a straight back, checked. No people.
shots.narration: 屈膝、直腰，贴近身体再起身。

shots.scene: 阿杰把箱子放上小推车
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places the box on a small lab cart with raised edges and pushes it.
shots.narration: 能用推车就用推车。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰两人一起抬
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student lift a heavy item together, both wearing lab coats and gloves.
shots.narration: 太重太大，叫人帮忙一起抬。

shots.scene: 高处架子上放着重物，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of heavy reagent bottles on the top shelf of a tall rack, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 重的东西放低处，不放高架。

shots.scene: 气瓶被横着在地上滚动，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gas cylinder being rolled on its side across the floor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 搬气瓶，不能在地上滚、拖。

shots.scene: 老李把戴好瓶帽的气瓶固定在专用推车上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer straps a capped gas cylinder onto a dedicated cylinder cart with a chain.
shots.narration: 戴好瓶帽，用专用推车固定好。

shots.scene: 到位后气瓶用链条固定在墙边
shots.prompt_en: The gas cylinder chained securely to a wall bracket in a lab. No people.
shots.narration: 到位后立刻固定，防止倾倒。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现彩色吊带和空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside colorful slings with a blank label highlighted.
shots.narration: 吊带能吊多重，以标签为准。

shots.scene: 检查放大镜和破损吊带打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a magnifying glass and a damaged sling crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 用前检查，有损伤就停用。

shots.scene: 证件和警戒线图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank certificate card and a barrier tape around a hanging load. No people.
shots.narration: 起重持证，吊物下面不站人。

shots.scene: 推车、屈膝搬运、气瓶推车图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lab cart, a person lifting with bent knees, and a cylinder cart. No people.
shots.narration: 重物用推车，气瓶用专用车。

shots.scene: 欣欣在问答台后挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye from behind the quiz desk with the question-mark lamp.
shots.narration: 绕开吊物走，下期再见！
